notifications.title: Notifications

settings.lead: These preferences apply to this device. Changes save immediately.
settings.languageLead: Chrome strings only (en-NZ or en-US). Format viewers keep their own copy.
settings.chromeFocusModeNote: Smaller tab strip and compact Command Manager. Hides the mods status line.
settings.largerHitTargetsNote: Bigger tabs, command buttons, and Command Manager tabs for touch or motor difficulty.
settings.boardSnap: Snap cards to grid when dragging
settings.midiScrubAudio: Play Web Audio beeps when scrubbing MIDI on the timeline
settings.crashRecoveryLabel: Back up dirty text and SVG to the config folder

crashRecovery.empty: No crash recovery backups on this device.
crashRecovery.restored: Restored unsaved content for {path}. Save when you are ready.
workspaceLayout.heading: Workspace layout
workspaceLayout.lead: Save window size, bookmark bar pins, split view, and command-manager toolbars as a named preset on this device.
workspaceLayout.nameRequired: Enter a name for this layout.
settings.newWindowNote: Each window keeps its own tabs, split view, and compare state. Theme, downloads, bookmarks, and toolbars stay shared on disk.
settings.ntpLead: Choose which blocks appear when you open a new tab.
settings.safeModeNote: Bundled format mods still load. User mods under ~/.config/unibrowser/mods and dev cdylib loads are skipped after restart. Or launch once with UNIBROWSER_SAFE_MODE=1.
settings.safeModeEnvActive: UNIBROWSER_SAFE_MODE=1 is set for this session. User mods are already disabled until you quit and launch without the flag.
settings.safeModeRestart: Restart Unibrowser for safe mode to take effect.
settings.updatesLead: Opens the releases page in your browser. No background check and no silent downloads.
settings.webviewDevtoolsNote: Opens developer tools on the https content webview for this window. For debugging only.
keys.lead: Chords from your keybindings file plus common navigation shortcuts.
pdf.highlightArmed: Drag on the PDF page to add a highlight (saved beside the file)
keys.overlayPlaceholder: Filter shortcuts by key or command…
settings.bookmarkBarLead: Pinned places and a few quick links sit under the tab strip. The bar lives in chrome and does not cover page content.
settings.bookmarkQuickLead: Optional quick links (https or paths) appear after your pinned places.
capture.savedGeneric: Capture saved to Downloads and opened in a new tab

crashLogs.heading: Crash logs

files.peekOpenHint: Click a file to extract and open

globalFind.title: Deep find (filename + text)

about.noticePath: Third-party notices: NOTICE.md and docs/licenses/ in the source or install tree.
about.noTelemetry: No telemetry. This build contains no analytics SDKs and sends no usage data.
about.privacyBody: Network access happens only for actions you choose (https pages, downloads, optional Open VSX). Preferences and notification history stay on your device.
about.privacyDocHint: Full policy: docs/privacy.md in the repository.
about.thirdPartyNote: Run ./scripts/generate-notice.sh to refresh the Rust dependency licence table.
